sections.heading: From CRUD to Intent
sections.body: We translate UI verbs directly into APIs: 'createNote', 'archiveNote', 'shareNote'. We hide tables and join logic behind application language. This improves clarity and reduces coupling between UI and storage details.

sections.heading: Shaping Responses
sections.body: Responses are story fragments: they include just enough to update the scene. We return stable identifiers, display-ready summaries, and status flags for syncing and undo.

sections.heading: Error Semantics
sections.body: Errors are also intents: 'policyDenied', 'rateLimited', 'networkDown'. We avoid generic 500s at the edges of the app and categorize errors into meaningful types. UI then maps types to repair paths.

sections.heading: Versioning the Narrative
sections.body: APIs evolve without breaking the story by adding fields and keeping defaults stable. We document change impact in vibe terms: 'undo becomes optional when server confirms within 80ms'.

sections.heading: Exercises
sections.body: Rewrite an API surface to reflect intents. Define error types and map them to visible, friendly messages in the UI.
